description: SAFE-page-only hero component: a 3D-flip image card that auto-flips every 10s until first user interaction, then only flips on click/Enter/Space. Shows two real product screenshots (investor interface / startup dashboard).

motion.autoFlip: flips every 10000ms until first user interaction (click/Enter/Space), which permanently disables the timer
motion.reducedMotionFallback: auto-flip timer never starts; flip on interaction is an instant state swap with no 3D rotate transition
